description: HeliosphericTomographySMEI fits a kinematic solar-wind model to Thomson-scattering observations from the SMEI instrument. The resulting three-dimensional reconstruction provides density information for heliospheric structures. The resource is documented by UCSD. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The model depends on a historical satellite observing system and should not be advertised as a current live feed. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
